description: An IEM library for calculating Ambisonics encoder, rotation, and decoder matrices in Pure Data. Current packaging supports higher-order 2D and 3D Ambisonics and identifies the IEM GitLab project as its homepage.

research.notes: The official GitLab project is independently corroborated by Debian and pd-lib-builder. No issue-tracker URL was returned by search, so it is left empty.
